title: Research Reports

body.text: searches dozens of sources and writes them up into a report with citations
— set the task and let it work for several minutes, getting a multi-page, structured report like an analyst wrote it.

example: "Research the EV market in Southeast Asia: market size, key players, each country's government policy, and the 3-year outlook"

title: Set the research task for a good report

body.text: scope (region/time period), the angle of interest, and the report format
— and review the research plan Gemini proposes before it starts, so you can steer it from the outset.

example: "Before starting, check the proposed research plan: if it's missing the Chinese-competitor angle, add it before confirming"
